title: How Bread Rises: Inside the Dough
description:
How bread rises is a gas story: yeast breathes out carbon dioxide, and a stretched gluten net catches every bubble. We travel inside the dough - from the bowl on the counter to the finished crumb - to watch mixing, rising, shaping, oven spring and cooling do their work.

CHAPTERS
0:00 The Dough That Doubled
0:23 Inside the Mix
0:57 The Yeast Engine
1:37 Shaping and the Second Rise
2:17 Oven Spring
2:54 The Finished Crumb

Yeast fermentation, the gluten network and oven spring are explained at magnified scale, with hours of rising time-compressed into seconds. The Explorer and the capsule are fictional guides; the process they show - how bread rises, why the net stretches instead of tearing, and why cooling finishes the loaf - follows the sources below.

AI-generated scientific visualization. The explorer and capsule are fictional storytelling devices. The process explanation is based on the sources below; scale, timing, color and visibility may be simplified. This is not real microscopic or factory footage.

VISUALIZATION CONVENTIONS
Magnified interior scale; hours of fermentation shown in seconds; bubbles and the gluten network enlarged as an explanatory picture; interior cutaway in the oven; fictional Explorer and capsule as guides.
